review_scope: Existing voltage/history to conditional intensity to binary counts only; no parameter adoption

equations.11: Total effective voltage adds a fitted linear filter of past spikes to membrane voltage

reported_output_fit.scope: Combined dynamic-clamp voltage/spike recordings from two ON-parasol RGCs; repeated-trial mean voltage

reported_membrane_conditions.role: Fixed CBEM model settings; these are not the dynamic-clamp recording reversal potentials

recording_dynamic_clamp_conditions.primary_methods: Dynamic clamp recordings; source Cafaro and Rieke 2013, DOI 10.1523/JNEUROSCI.4964-12.2013
recording_dynamic_clamp_conditions.recording_mode: Current clamp with conductance-based current injection

original_acquisition_context.conductance_scaling: Common E/I amplitude factor adjusted per dynamic-clamp cell; exact Fig3 values not supplied
original_acquisition_context.bias_current: Optional constant injected current below 200pA to support spontaneous firing; exact Fig3 values not supplied
original_acquisition_context.voltage_reference: 2013 paper reports -10mV liquid-junction correction; mapping to the two Fig3 exports is unresolved
original_acquisition_context.scope_limit: Acquisition-method cohort settings do not establish cell-specific correction, species, or injection values; no correction applied to project parameters

author_python.identity: Local bytes match git blob IDs in the frozen tree; this is a later author implementation, not a 2019 publication snapshot
author_python.output: alpha=90, mu=-53 mV, beta=1.67 mV; membrane plus voltage-valued history before division by beta
author_python.membrane_units: getVoltage multiplies g_tot by binSize_ms/1000; g_l=200 is per second, not siemens
author_python.history: Fitted spline-basis filter with support about 190 ms; no author basis/filter values copied into current three-bin kernel

publication_matlab_archive.access: Read through browser at pinned raw URLs; local raw download unavailable due restricted DNS; no MATLAB executed

setup_final_nonlinearity.history_unit: sph is dimensionless; equivalent voltage-valued history is sph/a mV
setup_final_nonlinearity.limit: Final setup initialization differs from the paper beta and later Python code; it is not evidence for the current project kernel or a fitted animal value

publication_matlab_archive.sampling: Binary binornd(1,1-exp(-dt*rate)); history uses only previous bins
publication_matlab_archive.time_units: Example sets dt=1e-4 seconds; setup header calls it milliseconds, but stimulus basis, dynamics and example use seconds. No such header ambiguity is present in current SI quantities
publication_matlab_archive.membrane_limit: Setup and fitting entry modify/add leak terms; copying a standalone setup value is not a reproduction of the paper membrane conditions

first_local_history.interpretation: Same output parameters and intensity formula already exist at the import. No earlier author-derived numeric provenance is established by local Git

classification.borrowed_structure: Conductance-driven graded membrane, linear past-spike term and softplus hazard are consistent with CBEM structure
classification.project_coefficients: All five families share C=60pF, gL=2nS, EL=-65mV, EE=0mV, EI=-80mV, alpha=150Hz, mu=-70mV, beta=5mV, [-12,-8,-4]mV history at 1ms bins. Coinciding reversal values do not change their declared project provenance
classification.initial_voltage: Derived from declared upstream/background conductance balance, not measured resting voltage
classification.history: Voltage impulse per binary past-bin count, not a Hz-valued firing-rate convolution; no extra dt multiplication
classification.time_scale: Leak-only C/gL=30ms versus paper normalized leak time 5ms; no capacitance-calibrated equivalence is claimed

diagnosis: Current implementation matches its declared SI formula and author-style binary observation rule. High leak-only firing is a predictable consequence of uncalibrated parameter placement and short history, not an established arithmetic/unit bug. Physiological applicability remains unvalidated

correction_choices.choice: Retain current project fixture and label the limitation
correction_choices.status: Executed by this audit; production unchanged
correction_choices.purpose: Preserve reproducibility and avoid treating equation correctness as physiological calibration

correction_choices.choice: Fit one approved output group against matched voltage/spike observations
correction_choices.required: Explicit RGC class and recording conditions, physical voltage origin, time-aligned spikes, repeat-mean voltage convention, compatible history/binning, disjoint train/validation/test and independent checks of background conductance balance
correction_choices.limit: No invented normal firing target; do not co-fit unconstrained upstream gains; one voltage point cannot identify the whole transfer function

correction_choices.choice: Create an isolated paper or pinned-author reference candidate
correction_choices.status: Requires explicit scientific scope confirmation before implementation
correction_choices.required: Select paper versus 2020 MATLAB versus 2022 Python, including membrane normalization, voltage/history units, bin size, data conditions and phenotype
correction_choices.limit: Do not transfer two ON-parasol output-fit values to all five classes or switch production defaults

non_corrections: A consistent absolute-to-relative voltage-origin conversion leaves all rates unchanged
A consistent V-to-mV conversion leaves all rates unchanged
Moving mu alone changes the scientific parameter; making mu more negative increases hazard at fixed V
Adding another dt factor to a per-spike voltage kernel changes the declared model
Changing the binary sampler to multi-event Poisson is not justified as a bug fix by the paper prose
Reducing dt while retaining three kernel samples changes the physical history support
